en: Colorized vintage postcard depicting a stone sculpture group of a bearded river god with flowing hair and drapery, accompanied by putti, seated on a platform in the middle of a reflective pond or lake. The statue stands in a formal palace garden with dense trees in the background at dusk. Printed German text appears at the top center identifying the location as the palace garden in Schwetzingen and the specific sculpture group.
